name: Name
catalogDescription: Manage upstream A2A agents served through the gateway.
removeAgentConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove agent {{name}}? Its gateway endpoints stop resolving and its virtual key grants are removed.
accessGuidance: Which callers may reach this agent. "Allowed by default" lets any valid virtual key through; otherwise only virtual keys with direct grants may reach it.
emptyTitle: Agents route A2A traffic through the gateway
emptyDescription: Register your first agent to serve its agent card and proxy A2A requests through Bifrost. Configure discovery, upstream authentication, and which virtual keys may reach it.
readMoreAria: Read more about the Agent Gateway (opens in new tab)
settingsLoadFailed: Failed to load Agent Gateway settings.
configurationNotLoaded: Configuration not loaded. Please refresh and try again.
externalClientDescription: Bifrost's public base URL, used for served agent cards and push-notification callback URLs. If left blank, agent cards fall back to the incoming Host header and push notifications are disabled. Supports env var syntax (e.g. env.BIFROST_EXTERNAL_URL).
pushDescription: View callback configurations registered through A2A and remove stale entries.
filterCopyHint: Click to filter · Right-click to copy
noPushMatches: No push configurations match these filters.
deletePushDescription: Bifrost will stop accepting and delivering push notifications for this callback. The upstream agent must register it again to restore delivery.
signInReturn: You can close this window and return to the Bifrost Agent.
grantTooltip: Grant this key access to registered agents. The key can then call each agent at <path>/agents/a2a/<name></path>. Agents marked open to all keys need no grant.
nameFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; no leading, trailing, or consecutive hyphens.
missingSecurityScheme: The card references a missing security scheme.
oneOAuthClient: The gateway supports one OAuth client per upstream.
oauthHeadersConflict: The gateway cannot combine OAuth with static header credentials.
duplicateHeaderCredential: The gateway cannot store separate credentials for the same HTTP header.
unsupportedCredential: The gateway does not support this query, cookie, or HTTP credential.
skipTlsDescription: Disable TLS certificate verification. Use only in trusted isolated environments. Takes priority over CA certificate.
caCertificateDescription: PEM-encoded CA certificate to trust for agent connections, such as a self-signed or private CA.
cannotExecuteRequirement: The selected card requirement cannot be executed.
fetchOrManual: Fetch the current agent card, or enable Advanced manual mode.
registerDescription: Register an A2A agent and configure how Bifrost connects to it.
cardAuthDescription: Used only for the server-side card fetch. It is never reused for agent requests.
cardTlsDescription: Custom certificate verification for HTTPS card discovery.
fetchCardPreview: Fetch the agent card to preview its capabilities, interfaces, and authentication.
extendedCardDescription: Bifrost can retrieve the extended card through the gateway using the configured agent request authentication.
requestAuthDescription: Choose one advertised alternative. Schemes joined with + are required together.
fetchCardAuth: Fetch the agent card to configure its advertised request authentication.
forwardAuthDescription: For agents that already use Bifrost for LLM or MCP calls. Configure the agent to send this authentication with those calls so access and usage stay attributed to the requester.
authConflictDescription: Applies only when the accepted credential and configured agent authentication use the same header. Other forwarded headers are unchanged.
authMismatch: Request authentication no longer matches the selected card requirement.
runtimeTlsDescription: Custom certificate verification for agent requests.
behaviorDescription: Control whether this agent receives traffic and who may reach it.
anyVirtualKey: Any valid virtual key can reach this agent.
virtualKeyGrantsDescription: Keys granted here can reach this agent through the gateway.
everyVirtualKey: Every valid virtual key can reach this agent.
manualAuthDescription: Bypass card-derived blocking and allow custom runtime authentication and extra headers.
tenantDescription: Advertise this tenant identifier on the served agent card.
extensionUrisDescription: Allow these A2A extensions to be advertised and activated for this agent.
searchLogs: Search agent, operation, or any identifier
noResults: No results found. Try adjusting your filters and/or time range.
logStoreMissing: Looks like you haven't configured the log store in your config file.
firstRequestDescription: Route an agent request through Bifrost to start collecting Agent Logs.
jsonRpcDescription: Send a strict A2A v1 SendMessage request over JSON-RPC.
httpDescription: Send the same message through the A2A HTTP+JSON binding.
registerEnabled: Register and enable the upstream agent in Agent Gateway.
requestVirtualKey: Use a virtual key that can access the agent, or remove the x-bf-vk header when authentication is disabled.
basicInformationDescription: Identify this agent and fetch its A2A card.
grpcUnavailable: gRPC is unavailable for this agent name
grpcNameLimit: gRPC routing uses the agent name as a DNS label, which is limited to 63 characters. JSON-RPC and REST remain available.
emptyResponseBody: The operation completed without a response body.
updateForwarded: Update forwarded to the client callback
noAgentResponse: The agent did not return a response.
pushSent: Push notification sent to client callback
noSessionOperations: No operations found for this session.
deleteLogConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this log?
deleteLogDescription: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete the log entry.
latencyDescription: Total end-to-end request time: upstream plus Bifrost overhead.
upstreamLatencyDescription: Time spent waiting on the upstream agent.
bifrostOverheadDescription: Time added by Bifrost itself: routing, plugins, and processing.
eventsDescription: Events show the ordered updates returned by the agent during this operation. Expand an event to inspect its data.
artifactUpdatedDescription: The agent emitted or updated output for this task.
statusUpdatedDescription: The agent reported a task state change.
taskSnapshotDescription: The agent returned the current task snapshot.
messageReceivedDescription: The agent emitted a message without creating or updating a task.
protocolEventDescription: A protocol event observed while this operation was active.
